data_description.connection_mode: Per poll: Home Assistant disconnects after each poll, so the phone app can connect in between. This costs a reconnect for every poll. Keep connected: updates are faster, but the cooker accepts only one Bluetooth connection, so the phone app cannot connect while Home Assistant holds it.
data_description.poll_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the cooker, in seconds (5 to 300). A short interval uses more Bluetooth traffic. While the cooker cannot be reached, Home Assistant waits longer between polls.

init.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to the cooker. The cooker accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

options.per_poll: Per poll (phone app can connect between polls)

start_cook.description: Sets the target temperature, starts heating and starts the timer when a duration is given.

duration.description: How long to cook. Rounded up to whole minutes. Leave empty to cook without a timer.

temperature.description: Target water temperature, in the unit system of Home Assistant.
